name: OP Battlegrounds
desc:
Immerse yourself in an anime battlegrounds, fight to become #1.

 💻 📱  Play OP Battlegrounds on computer & mobile devices!

CONTROLS:
G - Awaken
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Ragdoll Cancel
Double Tap W - Run
Left Click - Punch

⚠️ Game is still in beta! You may encounter bugs.
